definitions.change_pct: Last recorded mid over the first recorded mid in the window, minus one, in percent.
definitions.range_pct: Highest minus lowest recorded mid in the window, over the last mid, in percent.
definitions.realised_vol_pct: Standard deviation of log returns between consecutive bucket closes (48 buckets, empty buckets skipped) times the square root of their count, in percent; not annualised.
definitions.spread_ratio: Spread now over the instrument's single typical spread in the registry.
definitions.strength: For each currency, the mean over the recorded FX pairs it is in of +change (as base) or -change (as quote). Not a trade-weighted index.
